title: fix(as2): import statements emit no bytecode; typed vars already correct
description: import flash.filters.BlurFilter was compiled as ExprStmt(Identifier('import flash.filters.BlurFilter')) which emitted ActionGetVariable + ActionPop — a semantically-wrong no-op that could confuse Ruffle's trace output. Fixed in parser to return empty Block (no bytecode). Typed var declarations (var x:BlurFilter) and typed params were already handled correctly (strips :Type annotation, produces identical bytecode to untyped equivalent). Added tests: import emits zero bytes, import path string not present in bytecode, onEnterFrame with typed BlurFilter + Math.abs args produces same function body as untyped equivalent. Task closed immediately — fix + tests land in same commit.
